column1: # Canonical external-filter wrapper grammar (#10230). ONE canonical copy — every unwrap site
# stage_word, proc.sh _PROC_WRAPPERS walk, the hook suite's python oracle,
# known-external-tools.md table) restates or extracts from THIS list, and
# Verified 2026-10-13 against rtk-ai/rtk src/lib.rs + src/core/constants.rs on develop.
#   class:   exec        = executes the words after it as a command (unwrap to them)
#            meta        = rtk-native, never executes external argv (falls through to argv0 verdict)
#            flag-global = inert option legal before AND after an exec subcommand (clap global=true)
#            flag-string = option whose next word (or =value) is an opaque shell string — never a
#                          boundary-prefix atom (#10248); payload is unparsed-wrapper ask territory
#   payload: argv        = the trailing words ARE the argv (rtk run rm -rf ~ runs rm)
#            string-flag = -c/--command/--shell make a word a shell string (ask unparsed-wrapper)

column4: -c|--command|--shell make the payload a shell string
--shell makes the positional a script; upstream may join args to sh -c

column1: # Global flags: -v/-vv/-vvv/--verbose (count) and --skip-env — both clap global=true, legal
